title: Cookies and browser storage
body: Cookies travel with requests; localStorage stays in your browser until cleared. The table below lists storage set directly by this code, including the consent preference added with this policy. Necessary storage supports requested features. Analytics and marketing are optional and off until you choose.

title: First-party inventory
body: vestail_profile — cookie; necessary; declared country and buyer type; 365 days, cleared on sign-out. vestail_early_access — cookie; necessary; signed invitation authorization; 24 hours, cleared when signup completes. vestail-theme — localStorage; necessary preference; light/dark/auto appearance; no automatic expiry, until cleared. vestail-consent-v1 — localStorage; necessary; version, optional category choices and saved time; choice valid for 180 days, then requested again; the key remains until overwritten or cleared.
